description: This source file defines the main application widget (`NewsApp`) for a Flutter news app, including theme setup, route configuration, and a biometric authentication gate (`_BiometricGate`) that blocks app launch until authenticated. It also contains some internal classes for handling biometric authentication state.

classes.name: NewsApp
classes.description: Main application widget that sets up theming, routes, and authentication gate.

classes.name: _BiometricGate
classes.description: A widget that blocks the app UI behind biometric authentication, re-authenticating on app resume.

classes.name: _BiometricGateState
classes.description: State class for `_BiometricGate` managing biometric authentication flow and state.

classes.name: _BadRouteScreen
classes.description: A simple screen displayed when route arguments are missing or incorrect.

methods.name: _theme
methods.description: Defines the app's Material 3 theme, colors, and component styles.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the `NewsApp` widget, wrapping a `MaterialApp` inside a biometric gate.

methods.name: _checkAndAuthenticate
methods.description: Triggers biometric authentication process, updating state based on success or failure.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Performs biometric/device credential authentication with fallback options.

methods.name: _localizedReasonWithFallbackHint
methods.description: Generates localized prompt message based on available biometric types.
